errors.text_span: като стълбовете за всеки месец са групирани по години
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are grouped by year. The bars are grouped by month, and within each monthly group, the bars represent different years.

The description claims that for the year 2024, the value in December is over 125,000. According to the chart, the value for 2024 (gray bar) in December (XII) is approximately 112,000. The value over 125,000 in December corresponds to the year 2022 (blue bar).
